codename.description: Codename of the Debian release (e.g., bookworm, bullseye)

official.description: Official status: Official, Official Beta, or Unofficial

mirror.description: Local path or URL to Debian mirror root

out.description: Path where generated ISO images will be written

apttmp.description: Path for temporary apt cache (must not be on NFS)

nonfree_components.description: Comma-separated list of non-free components to include (e.g., non-free, non-free-firmware)

max_pkg_size.description: Maximum package size (in bytes) allowed on CDs (larger packages excluded)

imagesums.description: Generate checksum files for generated images

disktype.description: Disk type (e.g., CD, DVD, BD, STICK8GB)

omit_release_notes.description: Set to true to omit release notes and link to web version instead

publish_path.description: Local filesystem path for publishing jigdo files
